summary: GitHub Copilot now supports server-to-server authentication for GitHub Apps installed on organizations, available in public preview. Services and agents built with the GitHub Copilot SDK can now make requests on behalf of an organization without relying on a signed-in user’s credentials.
takeaways: Services and agents built with the GitHub Copilot SDK can now make requests on behalf of an organization without relying on a signed-in user’s credentials.
Developers can give a GitHub App the read-only Copilot Requests organization permission, install the app on an organization, and pass a short-lived installation access token to the Copilot SDK.
To get started, see server-to-server authentication for the GitHub Copilot SDK and managing GitHub App access to your organization’s Copilot .
